create_gcc_compilation_session: create a GCC compilation service session class using make_gcc_compilation_session with a gcc binary path
compile_benchmark_to_object: compile a benchmark source file to an object file using the GccCompilationSession compile method
assemble_benchmark_to_asm: assemble a benchmark source file to assembly code using the GccCompilationSession assemble method
apply_compiler_action: apply a SimpleAction or IncrAction to change GCC compiler flag choices in a session
get_observation: get an observation like asm_size obj_hash or instruction_counts from a GccCompilationSession
